import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

def qpow(a, b, P):
    ret = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            ret = ret * a % P
        a = a * a % P
        b >>= 1
    return ret

def lowbit(x):
    return x & -x

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    kk = int(data[1])
    P = int(data[2])
    
    ans = qpow(kk, n, P)
    if n & 1:
        print(ans)
        return
    
    fac = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % P
    inv = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv[n] = qpow(fac[n], P - 2, P)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        inv[i-1] = inv[i] * i % P
    
    # dp[cur][msk] for cur in 0..25, msk in 0..n
    dp = [[-1] * (n + 1) for _ in range(26)]
    
    def dfs(cur, msk):
        if dp[cur][msk] != -1:
            return dp[cur][msk]
        if msk == 0:
            # base case: fac[n] * P(kk, cur)
            val = fac[n]
            for i in range(1, cur + 1):
                val = val * (kk - i + 1) % P
            dp[cur][msk] = val
            return val
        tmp = msk - lowbit(msk)
        total = 0
        i = tmp
        while i:
            total = (total + inv[msk - i] * dfs(cur + 1, i)) % P
            i = (i - 1) & tmp
        total = (total + inv[msk] * dfs(cur + 1, 0)) % P
        dp[cur][msk] = total
        return total
    
    ans = (ans - dfs(0, n) + P) % P
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
